extracted.name: Slow Cooker Cheesy Hash Brown Potatoes
extracted.description: This cheesy crockpot hash brown casserole is an easy, tasty recipe that's great for potlucks and game-day parties — made right in a slow cooker.
ingredient_lines: 1 (30 ounce) package frozen shredded hash brown potatoes
2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Place frozen hash browns in a slow cooker. Pour melted butter over hash browns. Pour in condensed soup and sour cream, stirring between each addition. Add Cheddar cheese.
Cook on Low for 4 to 5 hours. Stir mixture after 2 hours of cooking.
